title: OpenBMI SSVEP EEG dataset (Lee et al. 2019)
description: A BIDS-formatted derivative of the OpenBMI SSVEP EEG dataset (Lee et al. 2019), prepared with the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB) framework. It contains 62-channel EEG recorded at 1000 Hz from 54 subjects over two sessions during a four-class steady-state visually evoked potential paradigm, totaling 21,600 trials of 4 s each. The dataset supports standardized analysis and benchmarking of SSVEP-based brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: This BIDS derivative was produced with MOABB (v1.2.0) from the OpenBMI dataset of Lee et al. (2019; GigaDB 10.5524/100542). EEG was recorded from 54 subjects across 2 sessions during an SSVEP paradigm with 4 stimulation classes (21,600 trials in total). Each trial was 4 s long, recorded at 1000 Hz from 62 EEG channels. Full experimental protocol details are given in the primary publication (doi:10.1093/gigascience/giz002).
